facts.fact: OHLGS launched a training workshop on the District Local Revenue (dL-Rev) software for 350 staff of 35 Municipal Assemblies, the first batch from 16 to 20 February 2026 in Kumasi.
The Office of the Local Government Service, a state body, runs the dL-Rev training under the Ghana Secondary Cities Support Programme.

systems.owner: Office of the Head of the Local Government Service
systems.tiers: 35 participating Municipal Assemblies of the Ghana Secondary Cities Support Programme (trained); MMDAs generally
